label: Circular progress rings
description: 1-3 circular progress rings (radial KPI gauges). Each ring has a faint track and a progress arc that draws from 12 o'clock, with a big mono number in the center and a label below. One ring renders large and centered; 2-3 render in a row with adaptive sizing. The center number either count-ups from 0 to pct (with % suffix) or shows a fixed value string. Optional eyebrow + title above.
validation: each .pr-arc stroke-dasharray set from literal circumference in the builder
center number count-up built from stepped tl.set(textContent)
